# RACS - Runtime Agent Control Standard

> Stable ID: valo.racs
> Canonical Role: Deterministic decision binding, permit/commit token issuance, and receipt schema layer.
> Receipt obligation: RACS receipt fields map to REHT-104 evidence obligations.

## Architectural Boundaries

- RACS binds REHT clearance and VAIG evaluation into single-use `CoreExecutionPermit` and `CommitToken`.
- RACS DOES NOT originate authority or widen clearance bounds.
- RACS DOES NOT execute mutations directly (owned by Core).

## Canonical Outcomes (6 Primitives)

`ALLOW | MODIFY | DEFER | STEP_UP | DENY | HALT`
